name: Kushiyanagi Chizuru
source:
A hardworking woman who works at the Ministry of Health, Labor and Welfare. She is highly intelligent, went to a graduate school and has always walked the path of the elite.
Chizuru wants a child but her husband suffers from azoospermia, so he's unable to have children with her.
